english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an attractively slender person.
Use this for a person's slim, attractively slender build, especially when describing a woman.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 san1 coi4 hou2 miu4 tiu5

examples.english: She has a slight, slender build and looks great in anything she wears.
examples.traditional: 佢身形好苗條，着咩衫都好靚。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 san1 jing4 hou2 miu4 tiu5 zoek3 me1 saam1 dou1 hou2 leng3
